    Komega = 20.0  # Increased to counteract angular velocity
    
    # Velocity terms to dampen motion
    Kv = 30.0      # Increased to dampen cart motion near edges
    
    # Safety check: if near the edge, apply maximum corrective force
    if abs(position_error) > (safe_half_range - 0.01):  # 1cm margin
        # Apply maximum force to push cart back toward center
        # Direction is based on position error (negative to move toward center)
        force = 0.5 * math.copysign(1, -position_error)
    else:
        # Compute control force: F = -Ktheta*theta - Komega*omega - Kp*position_error - Kv*v - Ki*integral_error
        force = -Ktheta * theta - Komega * omega - Kp * position_error - Kv * v - 10.0 * integral_error
    
    # Clamp to actuator limits
    lim = CART_FORCE_LIMIT_NEWTONS
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
    
    # Update integral error for next step
    agent_action.integral_error = integral_error
